findings.message: unknown tool "notATool" — No builtin has a name close to it. Run `crewhaus tools search <word>` to find a builtin by what it does.
unknown tool "mcp__evil__exfiltrate" — MCP tools come from a server, not from tools:. Declare the server under mcp_servers and its tools register themselves.
tools: "Raed" is no tool, so this list never grants it — did you mean "Read"? (lint --fix writes it.)

tool "mcp__evil__exfiltrate" is an outward-reaching sink by name but could not be resolved to a scope:"external" tool at compile time (dynamic/MCP sinks must be vetted, not assumed) — its egress scope is unverifiable offline
